BIDDER SUBMISSION PACKET
Bid Number GEM/2026/B/7910945
Buyer Office of ADG(E) North Zone, All India Radio & Doordarshan, Prasar Bharati (Ministry of Information &
Broadcasting)
Item Supply of LT Switchgear Panel with Sub Distribution Board — 4 sites (Farrukhabad, Mandi,
Pithoragarh, Leh)
Estimated Bid Value Rs. 25,48,600
Bidder Name Bharat Power Control Systems Pvt. Ltd.
Bidder Category Authorised Dealer/Distributor of OEM (not the manufacturer)
Offered OEM SwitchTech Panels Ltd.
Contains Udyam / GST / PAN & IT / EPFO / ESIC / Bidder Turnover / OEM Turnover / Experience & Past
Performance / OEM Authorisation / Make in India Declaration / Non-Blacklisting Declaration / Startup India &
NSIC status / EMD Proof / DigiLocker cross-check note
This packet is intended for evaluation against the thresholds stated in GeM Bid GEM/2026/B/7910945 (Prasar
Bharati). The bid's ATC clauses 7 and 8 override the generic turnover filter values shown in the bid summary
(Rs. 12 Lakh / Rs. 102 Lakh) with '200% of estimated bid value' and '400% of estimated bid value' respectively
— i.e. the effective thresholds are Rs. 50,97,200 (bidder) and Rs. 1,01,94,400 (OEM).
